description.p: Clustta simplifies file management, collaboration and version control for creative workflows. It provides a familiar, intuitive interface for managing assets, tracking changes, and collaborating with your team - designed specifically for creative professionals working with large files.

ul.li: Version control optimised for large binary files (images, video, audio, 3D models)
Visual asset browsing with thumbnails and metadata
Checkpoint-based history - save, compare, and restore any version
Organise assets with collections, tags, and dependencies
Works offline - sync when you're ready

screenshot.caption: Clustta desktop client showing asset browser with collections and thumbnails
Organize your creative work with project and task templates
Travel back in time with checkpoints and version history
Browse the complete version history of your files

description.p: Clustta 0.4.40 adds precise dependency version controls, checkpoint provenance, visible background activity, cross-platform drag-and-drop exports, and safer project updates.

ul.li: Pin dependencies to exact checkpoints or tagged versions and preview build downloads
Tag checkpoints, record their source lineage, and edit checkpoint details after creation
Track downloads and other long-running work in the new Activity panel
Drag eligible assets and collections into supported apps and file locations on Windows, macOS, and Linux
Start mixed-media work with the new Jack of All Trades project template
Includes improvements to project compatibility, sync, onboarding, authentication, dependency navigation, and interface polish
